content:
## UPS Aur Inverter Battery Backup Time Kaise Calculate Karein? (2026 Formula)

Pakistan ke har shehr—Karachi, Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan aur Peshawar—mein load shedding ya voltage fluctuations se nipatne ke liye taqreeban har ghar mein UPS ya Solar Hybrid Inverter nasab hota hai.

Lekin sab se aam masla yeh hai ke jab consumer shopkeeper se battery leta hai, to dukaandar kehta hai: *"Bhai yeh 200Ah ki battery hai, 6-7 ghante aaraam se chalegi!"*

Lekin ghar laane ke baad jab 2 fans aur 3 lights chalaye jate hain, to battery **2.5 se 3 ghante** mein low voltage trip kar jati hai. Akhir aisa kyun hota hai? Is article mein hum real mathematical formula, 70% Safe Depth of Discharge (DoD), inverter loss factor, aur NEPRA protected slab cliff ka asar tafseel se samjhein ge.

---

## 1. Dukaandar Ki Ghalat Calculation vs Haqeeqat

Aam tor par log yeh basic formula lagate hain:

> `Theoretical Backup = (Battery Ah × DC Volts) / Load in Watts`
> Maslan: (200Ah × 12V) / 300W = 2,400 / 300 = **8 Ghante**

Yeh calculation **100% ghalat** hai kyunke:
1. **Zero Cut-off Impossible:** Agar aap battery ko 100% discharge (0 Volts) kar dain ge, to lead plates andar se permanently sulface aur warp ho kar tabah ho jayen gi. Lead-acid/tubular battery sirf 100 cycles mein expire ho jaye gi.
2. **Inverter Heat Loss:** 12V DC ko 220V AC mein convert karne ke doran 12% se 18% power inverter ke transformer aur MOSFETs mein zaya hoti hai.
3. **Peukert's Effect:** Jitna heavy load daalenge, battery ki effective capacity utni hi tezi se giregi.

---

## 2. Real-World Battery Backup Formula (Certified 2026 Standard)

Accurate backup nikaalne ke liye yeh 4-step formula istemal karein:

```text
Real Backup Time (Hours) = [Battery Voltage (V) × Capacity (Ah) × Safe DoD (%) × Inverter Efficiency (%)] / Connected Load (Watts)
```

### Parameters Ki Tafseel:
- **Battery DC Voltage:** Single 12V battery = 12, Double battery series = 24V, 4-battery solar inverter = 48V.
- **Battery Capacity (Ah):** 100Ah, 150Ah, 180Ah, 200Ah, ya 230Ah.
- **Safe Depth of Discharge (DoD):**
  - **Tall Tubular Batteries (AGS SP-2000, Phoenix TX-1800/2500, Volta T-1800):** Safe limit **70% (0.70)** hoti hai.
  - **Standard Liquid Car/Automotive Batteries:** Safe limit sirf **50% (0.50)** hoti hai.
  - **Lithium LiFePO4 Batteries:** Safe limit **90% (0.90)** hoti hai.
- **Inverter Efficiency:** Aam Desi UPS ki 80% (0.80) aur pure sine wave hybrid inverters ki 85% (0.85) hoti hai.

---

## 3. Practical Example: 12V 200Ah Tall Tubular Battery Par Kitna Backup Milega?

Chalein ek typical Pakistani ghar ka calculation karte hain:
- **Battery:** 12V 200Ah Tall Tubular
- **Safe Usable Energy:** 12V × 200Ah × 0.70 (DoD) = **1,680 Watt-Hours (Wh)**
- **Inverter Ke Baad Deliver Shuda Energy:** 1,680 Wh × 0.85 = **1,428 net Wh**

### Load Scenarios:

### Scenario A: Halka Load (1 Fan + 3 LED Bulbs + WiFi Router)
- 1 Ceiling Fan (80W) + 3 LEDs (36W) + WiFi Router (15W) = **131 Watts**
- **Backup Time:** 1,428 / 131 = **10.9 Ghante (~10 ghante 54 minute)**

### Scenario B: Darmiyana Load (2 Fans + 4 LED Bulbs + 1 LED TV 43")
- 2 Ceiling Fans (160W) + 4 LEDs (48W) + 1 TV (90W) + WiFi (15W) = **313 Watts**
- **Backup Time:** 1,428 / 313 = **4.56 Ghante (~4 ghante 34 minute)**

### Scenario C: Bhari Load (3 Fans + Refrigerator Inverter Model)
- 3 Fans (240W) + Refrigerator continuous average (200W) + Lights (48W) = **488 Watts**
- **Backup Time:** 1,428 / 488 = **2.92 Ghante (~2 ghante 55 minute)**

---

## 4. Backup Time Comparison Table (12V Tubular Batteries)

| Battery Capacity | Safe Usable Energy (Wh) | Light Load (150W) | Medium Load (300W) | Heavy Load (600W) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **100 Ah** | 714 Wh | 4h 45m | 2h 20m | 1h 10m |
| **150 Ah** | 1,071 Wh | 7h 05m | 3h 30m | 1h 45m |
| **180 Ah** | 1,285 Wh | 8h 30m | 4h 15m | 2h 08m |
| **200 Ah** | 1,428 Wh | 9h 30m | 4h 45m | 2h 22m |
| **230 Ah** | 1,642 Wh | 10h 55m | 5h 28m | 2h 44m |

Apne system ka exact hisab lagane ke liye hamara free tool istemal karein: **[Interactive Battery Backup Calculator](/tools/battery-backup-calculator)**.

---

## 5. NEPRA 200-Unit Protected Slab Danger: Recharge Units Ka Chhupa Kharcha

Pakistani households aksar is baat ko nazar-andaz kar dete hain ke battery hawa se charge nahi hoti! Jab K-Electric ya WAPDA ki bijli wapas aati hai, to UPS charger battery ko recharge karne ke liye grid se bhari units khenchta hai.

### Math Samjhein:
- Ek 200Ah battery ko 70% discharge se 100% full karne ke liye internal chemical conversion losses ke sath taqreeban **2.0 se 2.3 units (kWh)** darkar hoti hain.
- Agar din mein 2 dafa load shedding ho, to rozana taqreeban **4.0 units** sirf UPS ki charging mein lagti hain.
- Mahana hisab se yeh **60 se 90 units** banti hain!

**Danger Alert:**
Agar aapka aam mahana consumption 150 units hai, to yeh 70 units recharge mil kar aapka total consumption **220 units** kar dega. Iska nateeja yeh hoga ke aap NEPRA ke **200-Unit Protected Slab** se bahar nikal jayenge. Protected slab ka rate taqreeban **Rs 16.50/unit** hota hai jabke 201 units cross hote hi aap unprotected **Rs 42.00+/unit** slab mein chale jate hain, jis se aapka bill foran **Rs 3,000 se seedha Rs 11,000+** ho jata hai!

Is qism ke jhatkon se bachne ke liye rozana apne meter ka reading lena aur burn-rate track karna lazmi hai.

---

## 6. Battery Ki Umar Barhane Ke 4 Sunheri Usool

1. **Monthly Distilled Water Level Check:** Tall tubular batteries mein acid nahi, sirf pure distilled battery water daalein. Plates kabhi bhi hawa mein exposed nahi honi chahiye.
2. **Avoid Fast Charging Beyond 25A:** Agar battery ko 30A ya 40A par charge karenge to plates overheat ho kar jaldi gir jayen gi. Standard 15A–20A charging current ideal hai.
3. **Low Voltage Cut-off Setting:** UPS setting mein cut-off voltage ko **10.5V se 10.8V** par set karein taake battery 70% DoD se zyada discharge na ho.
4. **Daily Reading Monitor Karein:** Read Meter web app (**[www.readmeter.online/guest](/guest)**) open karein aur camera se meter ka snapshot lein taake aapko maloom rahe ke UPS ki wajah se slab cross hone ka khatra to nahi ban raha.

faqs.question: 200Ah battery par 2 fans aur 4 lights kitni dair chal sakti hain?
faqs.answer: 12V 200Ah Tall Tubular battery par 2 standard fans aur 4 LED lights ka total load taqreeban 208 Watts hota hai. 70% safe depth of discharge aur 85% inverter efficiency ke sath yeh battery taqreeban 6 ghante 50 minute ka continuous backup faraham karti hai.

faqs.question: Kya UPS battery ko mukammal 100% discharge karna chahiye?
faqs.answer: Hargiz nahi! Lead-acid ya tall tubular battery ko 70% se zyada discharge karne se plates par lead sulfate crystalize ho jata hai jis se battery ki zindagi 3 saal se gir kar sirf 6 se 8 maah reh jati hai.

faqs.question: Ek 200Ah battery ko full charge hone mein kitni units bijli lagti hai?
faqs.answer: Mukammal discharged 200Ah tubular battery ko full charge karne mein inverter aur chemical conversion losses ke sath taqreeban 2.0 se 2.4 units (kWh) bijli lagti hai.
